summary.headline: Astrological Diagnosis and Remedies
summary.text: Iatromathematical guidance on judging diseases from decumbiture inceptions, lunar phases, nodes, aspects, and planetary rays, citing Hermes, Petosiris, and Protagoras. It correlates planets and zodiacal signs with illnesses and prescribed remedies, including purgations, diuretics, cupping, and phlebotomy.
